This matches the spirit of the expected root cause: identifying telemetry gaps as central to the difficulty of diagnosis, while still being evidence-based rather than pure guessing.

This is a good match in substance, though the investigation leans more toward presenting a confident "leading explanation" than purely "reporting gaps without guessing" - it does both.
